flow.label: DB Intelligent Analysis
flow.name: taskflow_db_analysis_template
flow.description: Schema grounding → analysis plan → pivot analysis → numeric review → HTML analysis report, a multi-agent chain.

config.goal: Profile the database: table list with row counts, key column types and comments, enum column values, join hints; mark analyzable tables and dimensions for the user's question; use sql_query for metadata and bounded aggregates only, no full scans. Output a semantic card (tables/columns/calibers/dialect) plus a volume overview.

From the upstream semantic card and the user's question, propose 3-5 highest-value business analysis questions (state metric calibers and comparison baselines); light sql_query probes allowed to confirm feasibility. Output the analysis plan list, do not start analyzing.

Answer each upstream plan question: verify with sql_query, post-process with code_interpreter when needed; per question give conclusion + key numbers + one-sentence explanation; finally aggregate into structured analysis conclusions.

Independently recompute the key numbers of the upstream conclusions with SQL rewritten from the calibers (do not reuse upstream SQL); mark each item confirmed/corrected with difference notes. Output a review table.

Compose a business-facing analysis report from the upstream profile, conclusions and review notes: title, core conclusions (at most 3), key data, trends and anomalies, actionable recommendations. Use the reviewed numbers. Finally compose the report as a self-contained HTML document (title, core conclusions, key data, trends and anomalies, recommendations, inline styles) and render it with a single html_interpreter call; after rendering succeeds, terminate with at most 3 sentences summarizing the core conclusions — never paste raw tool output or JSON as the answer.
